contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ M AVR CARINVS NOB CAES ; R/ PIETAS [AV]GG

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carinus (283-285), mint of Rome issue of 282-283 (282 in Sear vol. 3 no. 12296, citing RIC vol. 5 part 2, no. 155), Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: M AVR CARINVS NOB CAES. Reverse description: Sacrificial implements. Reverse inscription: PIETAS [AV]GG. In exergue: KAZ. Diameter: 20.9mm, Weight: 2.59gms, die axis: 6
